title: By Faith

questions.question: Now faith is the assurance of things hoped for, the conviction of things not ____.
questions.explanation: Hebrews 11:1 (ESV): "Now faith is the assurance of things hoped for, the conviction of things not seen."

questions.question: By faith we understand that the universe was created by the ____ of God, so that what is seen was not made out of things that are visible.
questions.explanation: Hebrews 11:3 (ESV): "By faith we understand that the universe was created by the word of God, so that what is seen was not made out of things that are visible."

questions.question: By faith ____ offered to God a more acceptable sacrifice than Cain, through which he was commended as righteous, God commending him by accepting his gifts.
questions.explanation: Hebrews 11:4 (ESV): "By faith Abel offered to God a more acceptable sacrifice than Cain, through which he was commended as righteous, God commending him by accepting his gifts. And through his faith, though he died, he still speaks."

questions.question: By faith ____ was taken up so that he should not see death, and he was not found, because God had taken him.
questions.explanation: Hebrews 11:5 (ESV): "By faith Enoch was taken up so that he should not see death, and he was not found, because God had taken him. Now before he was taken he was commended as having pleased God."

questions.question: And without ____ it is impossible to please him, for whoever would draw near to God must believe that he exists and that he rewards those who seek him.
questions.explanation: Hebrews 11:6 (ESV): "And without faith it is impossible to please him, for whoever would draw near to God must believe that he exists and that he rewards those who seek him."

questions.question: By faith ____, being warned by God concerning events as yet unseen, in reverent fear constructed an ark for the saving of his household.
questions.explanation: Hebrews 11:7 (ESV): "By faith Noah, being warned by God concerning events as yet unseen, in reverent fear constructed an ark for the saving of his household. By this he condemned the world and became an heir of the righteousness that comes by faith."

questions.question: By faith ____ obeyed when he was called to go out to a place that he was to receive as an inheritance. And he went out, not knowing where he was going.
questions.explanation: Hebrews 11:8 (ESV): "By faith Abraham obeyed when he was called to go out to a place that he was to receive as an inheritance. And he went out, not knowing where he was going."

questions.question: For he (Abraham) was looking forward to the city that has foundations, whose designer and builder is ____.
questions.explanation: Hebrews 11:10 (ESV): "For he was looking forward to the city that has foundations, whose designer and builder is God."

questions.question: By faith ____ herself received power to conceive, even when she was past the age, since she considered him faithful who had promised.
questions.explanation: Hebrews 11:11 (ESV): "By faith Sarah herself received power to conceive, even when she was past the age, since she considered him faithful who had promised."

questions.question: These all died in faith, not having received the things promised, but having seen them and greeted them from afar, and having acknowledged that they were ____ and exiles on the earth.
questions.explanation: Hebrews 11:13 (ESV): "These all died in faith, not having received the things promised, but having seen them and greeted them from afar, and having acknowledged that they were strangers and exiles on the earth."

questions.question: But as it is, they desire a better country, that is, a ____ one. Therefore God is not ashamed to be called their God, for he has prepared for them a city.
questions.explanation: Hebrews 11:16 (ESV): "But as it is, they desire a better country, that is, a heavenly one. Therefore God is not ashamed to be called their God, for he has prepared for them a city."

questions.question: By faith ____, when he was tested, offered up Isaac, and he who had received the promises was in the act of offering up his only son,
questions.explanation: Hebrews 11:17 (ESV): "By faith Abraham, when he was tested, offered up Isaac, and he who had received the promises was in the act of offering up his only son,"

questions.question: By faith ____, when he was dying, blessed each of the sons of Joseph, bowing in worship over the head of his staff.
questions.explanation: Hebrews 11:21 (ESV): "By faith Jacob, when he was dying, blessed each of the sons of Joseph, bowing in worship over the head of his staff."

questions.question: By faith ____, when he was born, was hidden for three months by his parents, because they saw that the child was beautiful, and they were not afraid of the king's edict.
questions.explanation: Hebrews 11:23 (ESV): "By faith Moses, when he was born, was hidden for three months by his parents, because they saw that the child was beautiful, and they were not afraid of the king's edict."

questions.question: By faith the people crossed the ____ Sea as on dry land, but the Egyptians, when they attempted to do the same, were drowned.
questions.explanation: Hebrews 11:29 (ESV): "By faith the people crossed the Red Sea as on dry land, but the Egyptians, when they attempted to do the same, were drowned."

key_verse_text: Now faith is the assurance of things hoped for, the conviction of things not seen.
